Copper alloy coin fragment. Radiate indeterminate, later Roman issue of 260-296, from the appearance of a partial legend probably irregular. Obverse description: Radiate head right. Obverse inscription: [--]VS [PF] AVG. Reverse description: figure possibly standing left. Reverse inscription: possibly [-]LAET[ITIA AVG]. Diameter: 16.5mm, Weight: 0.91gms, die axis: possibly 12
